description: This file defines an abstract class `DownloadEngine` that provides a minimal interface for simulating offline downloads within a Flutter application. It outlines methods for starting and canceling downloads, intended for simulation purposes without actual media fetching.

classes.name: DownloadEngine
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a minimal interface for simulating download progress and control actions such as start and cancel.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Simulates starting a download process for specified content and reports progress via callback.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Simulates canceling an ongoing download for specified content.
